description: This file initializes and runs an FTP server within an Odoo module, setting up threading, IP detection, and logging.

classes.name: ftp_server
classes.description: A thread class that sets up and runs an FTP server with custom IP detection and logging.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs messages to the FTP channel with specified level.

methods.name: detect_ip_addr
methods.description: Detects the server's IP address, using fcntl on UNIX or socket hostname otherwise.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Initializes FTP server parameters, sets up logging, and starts the server.
